bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo 'UNAUTHORIZED_ALL_CHANNEL_JOB_BEFORE'
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-all-joined-retry-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result --no-pager || true
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result --no-pager || true
echo 'STOP_UNAUTHORIZED_ALL_CHANNEL_WORKERS'
for unit in gace-public-video-all-joined-retry-20261114.service gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service; do
  if test "$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null)" = active; then
    systemctl --user stop "$unit"
  fi
  state="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || true)"
  echo "$unit=$state"
  test "$state" != active
done
echo 'PROTECT_RESIDENT_USERBOT'
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
mountpoint -q /mnt/g
test -d /mnt/g/GserverStorage
echo 'EXISTING_PRIORITY_WORKER'
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-collect-retry-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p Result --no-pager || true
echo 'PRIORITY_PROGRESS'
if test -f /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/_jobs/thegreatolddaysofnippongv.json;then cat /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/_jobs/thegreatolddaysofnippongv.json;fi
echo 'OTHER_CHANNEL_FILES_ALREADY_PRESENT'
find /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type f ! -path '/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443/*' -printf '%h/%f %s\n' | head -30
echo 'RESIDENT_HEALTH'
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
